title: Distributed Real-Time Emulation of Formally-Defined Patterns for Safe Medical Device Control
review_status: full-text audit complete; formal pattern, timing assumptions, pacemaker simulator and physical syringe-pump case studies, and excluded safety modes checked
sections_checked: formal pattern and logical/physical time mapping
pacemaker simulator case and jitter results
physical NE-500 syringe-pump case and scale validation
evidence_note: Pacemaker scenario uses a Java simulator, with jitter mostly below 0.1s and almost never above 0.2s on a stated 1.67GHz Windows/Cygwin setup. A physical syringe pump is checked in one execution using scale readings. Guarantees depend on timing assumptions and one command-shaper pattern; network-disconnection/open-loop safety and other safety classes are explicitly out of scope.

title: Requirements Engineering Methods: A Classification Framework and Research Challenges
review_status: full-text audit complete; five-component taxonomy, intended uses, validation challenge, and framework limitations checked
evidence_note: Conceptual classification framework intended for analysis, teaching, extension, design, and validation. The paper itself identifies systematic REM validation as an open challenge and says the framework is limited; it provides neither an empirical effectiveness estimate nor a complete validation procedure.

title: A Critical Review of "Automatic Patch Generation Learned from Human-Written Patches": Essay on the Problem Statement and the Evaluation of Automatic Software Repair
review_status: full-text audit complete; defect-class framing, repair settings, correctness/understandability/completeness criteria, and acceptability argument checked
evidence_note: Conceptual essay argues repair criteria depend on problem statement and intended deployment: recommendation versus fully automatic repair have different correctness, understandability, and completeness obligations. A test-suite oracle only specifies tested behavior; fix acceptability may be underdetermined for unspecified inputs. Not an empirical estimate.

title: Mining Software Repair Models for Reasoning on the Search Space of Automated Program Fixing
review_status: prior full-text audit reconciled for exact frozen sample version; not counted as a new read
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2013-11-14; exact v1 PDF audited in batch 27
evidence_note: Analyzes 89,993 transactions from 14 Java repositories (62,179 with Java changes) and models attempts over 23,048 small fix transactions. Attempt counts are probabilistic search-space analysis, not measured end-to-end runtime; authors note classifier and sampling/language limitations.

title: Using Formal Specifications to Support Model Based Testing ASDSpec: A Tool Combining the Best of Two Techniques
review_status: prior full-text audit reconciled for exact frozen sample version; not counted as a new read
